tour.name: Jordan Highlights 8-Day Private Tour: Amman, Jerash, the Dead Sea, Petra, Wadi Rum & Aqaba
tour.subtitle: Eight days across Jordan with private guides and a vehicle: Amman and Roman Jerash, Madaba and Mount Nebo, the King's Highway and Kerak, two days in Petra with Petra by Night, a night in a Wadi Rum desert camp, the Red Sea at Aqaba and the Dead Sea.
tour.metaDescription: 8-day private Jordan tour: Amman, Jerash, Madaba, Mount Nebo, the King’s Highway, Petra over two days, Wadi Rum desert camp, Aqaba and the Dead Sea. Guides, vehicle, entrances and 7 nights included.
highlights: Roman Jerash and the Amman Citadel
Madaba, Mount Nebo and the King’s Highway
Two days in Petra, with Petra by Night
A night in a Wadi Rum desert camp
Snorkelling in the Red Sea at Aqaba
Private guides and a driver throughout
tour.overview:
Jordan is small, safe and remarkably varied: Roman cities, Crusader castles, the rose-red city of Petra, the red desert of Wadi Rum, the coral reefs of the Red Sea and the Dead Sea, all within a few hours of each other. This private tour links them with a driver throughout and licensed guides at each site.

You have seven nights in well-located hotels and a desert camp, with time to enjoy Petra over two days and to relax by the Red Sea and the Dead Sea.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 8 days, 7 nights
• Start and end: Queen Alia airport, Amman
• Type: private tour with licensed guides, vehicle and driver; 7 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• Amman and Jerash.
• Madaba, Mount Nebo and Kerak.
• Petra.
• Wadi Rum.
• Aqaba.
• The Dead Sea.

WHY THIS WORKS
The loop from Amman south along the King’s Highway and back along the Dead Sea avoids backtracking and makes every day count.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors, couples, families and small groups.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
Add Dana and Feynan for hiking, or extend the Red Sea stay.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The Jordan Pass, bought online before travel, covers the visa and most entrances, including Petra; we can include or deduct it.

private: 7 nights with breakfast: 2 in Amman, 2 in Petra, 1 in a Wadi Rum camp, 1 in Aqaba, 1 at the Dead Sea
Entrances in the programme, Petra by Night and the Wadi Rum jeep tour

days.name: Arrival in Amman
days.description:
What to expect: a private welcome.

Your driver meets you at Queen Alia airport and takes you to your hotel in Amman. In the evening, walk along Rainbow Street.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Any time – Airport transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Visa on arrival or the Jordan Pass.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Amman.
Meals: none.

days.name: Jerash, Ajloun and Amman
days.description:
What to expect: Roman Jordan.

Jerash, Ajloun Castle, the Amman Citadel, the Roman theatre and the downtown souks.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Jerash.
13:30 – Ajloun.
15:15 – Amman Citadel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Try knafeh downtown.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, entrances.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: hotel in Amman.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: The King's Highway to Petra
days.description:
What to expect: mosaics, canyons and castles.

Madaba, Mount Nebo, Wadi Mujib, Kerak Castle, the Dana viewpoint and Shobak, arriving in Petra.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Madaba.
12:15 – Kerak.
15:45 – Shobak.
17:00 – Petra.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring a torch for Kerak.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, entrances.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: hotel in Petra.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Petra, and Petra by Night
days.description:
What to expect: the rose-red city.

A full day with your guide: the Siq, the Treasury, the Royal Tombs, the colonnaded street and the Monastery, and Petra by Night when it runs.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – The Siq and the Treasury.
13:30 – The Monastery.
20:30 – Petra by Night.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Petra by Night runs Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

INCLUDED: guide, entrance, Petra by Night.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: hotel in Petra.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Little Petra and Wadi Rum
days.description:
What to expect: the desert.

Little Petra, then Wadi Rum by 4x4 with a Bedouin guide, sunset on the dunes, a zarb dinner and a night at a desert camp.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Little Petra.
11:30 – Jeep tour.
Sunset – Dunes.
19:30 – Zarb dinner.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Nights are cold in winter.

INCLUDED: vehicle, jeep, guide, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: desert camp in Wadi Rum.
Meals: breakfast, dinner.

days.name: Aqaba and the Red Sea
days.description:
What to expect: coral reefs.

Sunrise in the desert, then the drive to Aqaba for a private boat, snorkelling at the Japanese Garden and a free afternoon.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Sunrise – Wadi Rum.
10:00 – Drive to Aqaba.
11:30 – Snorkelling.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Use reef-safe sun cream.

INCLUDED: vehicle, boat, guide, equipment.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Aqaba.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: To the Dead Sea
days.description:
What to expect: the lowest point on Earth.

The drive north along the Dead Sea Highway, with a stop at the baptism site, and an afternoon floating in the Dead Sea at your resort.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Departure.
13:00 – Baptism site.
15:00 – Dead Sea resort.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring swimwear.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, entrance.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: resort at the Dead Sea.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Departure
days.description:
What to expect: a private transfer to the airport.

A last float at sunrise if you wish, then your driver takes you to Queen Alia airport, about 1 hour.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
As needed – Airport transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Allow 3 hours before your flight.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Is the Jordan Pass included?
faq.answer: We can include it or deduct entrances if you buy it yourself; it covers the visa when you stay 3 nights or more.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 4-star hotels, a desert camp and a Dead Sea resort; upgrades are available.

faq.question: Is Jordan safe?
faq.answer: Yes, Jordan is one of the safest and most welcoming countries in the region.

faq.question: Can we add hiking?
faq.answer: Yes: Dana and Feynan, or the Wadi Mujib Siq Trail in season.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. We book family rooms and adapt the walking.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. Petra involves much walking; we can arrange carts.

faq.question: Can we start in Aqaba?
faq.answer: Yes, the loop can be reversed or start at Aqaba airport.

faq.question: Are meals included?
faq.answer: Breakfast daily and dinner at the desert camp; guides suggest restaurants.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Walking shoes, modest clothes, layers for the desert, swimwear and sun protection.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: March to May and September to November.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Jordan: guides and drivers appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
